name: bicg_v4
description: The one pass over A with a bank: q's half `matvec/matvec_v2` (a `dot_v2` group per row), s's half `matvec/matvec_v8`, so s's N sums stay in the `Mac`'s bank of R rows of W (D191) and r is read once a row and held (D190); A is read once by both (`fork_read`, D189). One strip: N = R·W (64 × 64 at W = 4, R = 16).
